Women's Shootout Tucson

Tucson, AZ · Menlo Park

Women / trans / femme

Women's Shootout Tucson is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It meets every Saturday, meet 6:00 am, roll 6:15 am (shifts with season), starting at Mercado San Agustín. Expect about 30, 40 or 50 miles, road ride, cycling experience required.

About the Women's Shootout Tucson group ride

A women's Saturday road ride from the Mercado on Tucson's west side. Pick 30, 40 or 50 miles. Organizers ask for some road riding experience. Check the Instagram for seasonal start times.
